subject: In est.map(drop.markers(temp, mnames[j]), error.prob = error.prob, : Didin't converge!

messages.author: ac1099cfd4f2b3f2
messages.subject: In est.map(drop.markers(temp, mnames[j]), error.prob = error.prob, : Didin't converge!
parts:
Hi all,

I am running dropone in this way:

dropone <- droponemarker(cross, error.prob=0.00025)

And at the end I am obtaining the next warning message:

In est.map(drop.markers(temp, mnames[j]), error.prob = error.prob,  :
  Didn't converge!

If is possible I would like to understand this warning message. Which is the problem?

I calculated the error portability using what is described under the title "Estimate genotyping error rate" from the linkage map tutorial available here: http://www.rqtl.org/tutorials/geneticmaps.pdf

I calculated the error probability before run orderMarkers, This could be the problem?

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] In est.map(drop.markers(temp, mnames[j]), error.prob = error.prob, : Didin't converge!
parts:
droponemarker() calls est.map(), with each successive marker omitted.

est.map() uses an iterative algorithm to estimate the map and calculate the log likelihood. This warning is issued if the algorithm reaches the specified maximum number of observations (maxit) without the inter-marker distances having stabilized to within the specified tolerance (tol).

You can probably ignore the warning, as for the purposes of comparing the maps with markers dropped one at a time, you don't need to get super clean estimates.

karl
